title: Scrap bronze

sections.heading: Introduction

full_text:
Scrap bronze

Type: Ore | Internal ID: BronzeScrap | Source: Charred Fortress | Usage: Smelting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): No

Introduction. Scrap bronze is a raw metal that can be turned into Bronze in a Smelter using Coal as fuel.

Availability. • From destroying the defensive spikes on Charred Fortresses.

Notes. • Like other metals, Scrap bronze cannot be teleported without a Portal stone.
• This item shares a sprite with Copper scrap.
• This item is the only way to obtain Bronze via the Smelter - Bronze is otherwise crafted at a Forge.
